name: Venus Yield Guard
description: Yield agent on BNB Smart Chain Testnet. Keeps part of its tBNB supplied to the Venus Core Pool vBNB market, sizes the share by live supply APY (80% at >=3%, 50% at >=0.5%, exit below), rebalances outside a 5% band and harvests accrued interest daily. Every action is a mint/redeem transaction with its reason published in status.json.
